{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.68

|gr1= Dynamic Simulation

|descr= Sets activation distance multiplier of [[Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation]] for the given class

|s1= class [[setDynamicSimulationDistanceCoef]] multiplier

|p1= class: [[String]] - multiplier class, currently only:
* {{hl|"IsMoving"}} - Multiplies the entity activation distance by set value if the entity is moving. Default: 2
|p2= multiplier: [[Number]] - distance multiplier

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>"IsMoving" setDynamicSimulationDistanceCoef 3;</sqf>

|seealso= [[enableDynamicSimulationSystem]] [[dynamicSimulationSystemEnabled]] [[enableDynamicSimulation]] [[dynamicSimulationEnabled]] [[setDynamicSimulationDistance]] [[dynamicSimulationDistance]] [[dynamicSimulationDistanceCoef]] [[triggerDynamicSimulation]] [[canTriggerDynamicSimulation]] [[enableSimulation]] [[simulationEnabled]] [[enableSimulationGlobal]] [[Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation]]
}}
